    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AcuityTier
    Clinical acuity triage tiers dictating patient queue priority and escalation urgency.
    AdmissionRequest
    Entity representing an inpatient admission request lifecycle from emergency department triage through bed allocation, transfer, inpatient stay, and discharge.
    AdmissionRequestRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for AdmissionRequest entity operations.
    AdmissionsApplication
    Main entry point for the Intelligent Patient Flow and Bed Capacity Orchestration System.
    AdmissionStatus
    Represents the lifecycle stages of an admission request.
    AdmittingClusterRequest
    Request payload for updating the admitting specialty cluster of an admission request.
    AssessmentBroadcast
    Entity representing a clinical assessment broadcast dispatched to specialist pools for secondary acuity assessment or subspecialty consults.
    AssessmentBroadcastRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for AssessmentBroadcast entity operations.
    AuditableEntity
    Base mapped superclass tracking audit timestamps and principal identities across entities.
    AuditLogger
    Structured audit logging utility providing immutable traceability for clinical and operational actions.
    AuthController
    REST controller for authentication and user persona discovery.
    BatchApprovalRequest
    Request payload for approving a batch allocation of cohort-compatible patients into an available holding ward.
    BatchSuggestion
    BMU solver suggestion for batch-allocating multiple ED boarding patients sharing common ward class, gender, and infection status to a holding ward.
    Bed
    Entity representing an individual hospital bed within a ward, including its telemetry capabilities, proximity to the nursing station, cleaning status, and current occupancy.
    BedAllocationRequest
    Request payload for allocating a specific bed to an admission request, optionally including rank, score, and clinical/operational override reasons.
    BedAllocationSolver
    Strategy interface for scoring and recommending available inpatient beds for an admission request.
    BedDeallocationRequest
    Request payload for deallocating or reverting an assigned bed back to the unallocated queue.
    BedDto
    Data transfer record representing a bed with telemetry capabilities and occupancy information.
    BedRecommendation
    Solver recommendation representing an evaluated bed candidate with objective scores, scoring breakdown components, and safety constraint evaluation results.
    BedRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Bed inventory entity operations.
    BedStatus
    Status enumeration for physical hospital beds with associated UI color coding and descriptions.
    BmuAlgorithmConfig
    Configuration entity controlling the weights and thresholds used by the BMU optimization and bed allocation solvers.
    BmuAlgorithmConfigRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for persistent BmuAlgorithmConfig parameter settings.
    BmuCapacityForecastDto
    Aggregate 24 to 72-hour discharge capacity projections for BMU coordinators.
    BmuCapacityForecastDto.ClusterCapacityProjection
    Specialty cluster level projection of anticipated bed capacity.
    BmuCapacityForecastDto.WardCapacityProjection
    Ward-level projection of anticipated bed capacity over upcoming time horizons.
    BmuConfigUpdateRequest
    Request payload for modifying dynamic weights and batching thresholds used in BMU optimization.
    BmuController
    REST controller for Bed Management Unit (BMU) operations.
    BmuService
    Core business service for the Bed Management Unit (BMU).
    BroadcastStatus
    Lifecycle status of an assessment broadcast to specialists.
    ChainConsultRequest
    Request payload for chaining a secondary or cross-specialty consult to another department.
    ClinicalBaselineOverride
    Represents a clinician override of automated triage baseline data with audit rationale.
    ClinicianController
    REST controller for Emergency Department (ED) and Inpatient Specialist clinical workflows.
    ClinicianService
    Service managing Emergency Department triage assessments and Specialist Consult Broadcasts.
    CohortSwapApprovalRequest
    Request payload for approving a suggested cohort swap of an inpatient to release a locked bed.
    CohortSwapSuggestion
    Suggestion produced by BMU solvers to relocate an existing patient to another bed/ward, unlocking multi-bed cohort rooms for waiting patients.
    DataInitializer
    Bootstrap component that populates the embedded H2 database with realistic prototype clinical data.
    DelayReasonCode
    Standard delay reason categories for patient admissions and transfers, including standardized patient/family talking points.
    DelayTagRequest
    Request payload for tagging an admission request with an operational delay reason code and notes.
    DischargeRunwayDto
    DTO representing an inpatient on the discharge runway.
    DischargeRunwayStage
    Dynamic operational stage representing patient progress along the discharge runway.
    DiversionPathway
    Available diversion care pathways to avoid acute inpatient admissions.
    DiversionReferralRequest
    Request payload for referring an acute patient to a partner sister hospital or community facility.
    EdAssessmentSubmitRequest
    Request payload submitted by emergency department clinicians capturing triage findings, acuity tier, required service cluster, telemetry needs, and specialist consult requirements.
    EddConfidence
    Clinical confidence level associated with an Estimated Date of Discharge (EDD).
    EddUpdateRequest
    Payload for setting or updating Estimated Date of Discharge (EDD).
    FhirHospitalEhrGateway
    Production implementation of HospitalEhrGateway integrating with enterprise HL7 Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) R4 servers.
    FollowUpNoteRequest
    Request payload for appending follow-up clinical or social notes to an admission.
    Gender
    Biological gender used for patient cohorting and ward room gender constraints.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Global REST exception handler producing RFC 7807 ProblemDetail representations.
    HeuristicBedAllocationSolver
    Prototype heuristic implementation of BedAllocationSolver.
    HospitalEhrGateway
    Gateway contract for accessing Electronic Health Record (EHR) data from institutional hospital systems.
    HospitalKpiSummaryDto
    Consolidated executive summary DTO containing operational KPIs across Epics 1 through 4.
    HttpSisterHospitalGateway
    Production implementation of SisterHospitalGateway connecting to external regional hospital APIs via mutual TLS (mTLS) and OAuth2 security.
    InfectionStatus
    Infection status classifications dictating isolation and negative pressure requirements.
    JpaAuditConfig
    JPA Auditing configuration to automatically populate createdBy and lastModifiedBy entity properties using the current Spring Security context.
    KpiAnalyticsController
    REST API controller exposing hospital-wide operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
    KpiMetricsService
    Service calculating hospital-wide operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across Epics 1 through 4 with division-by-zero guards.
    MedicationDeliveryStatus
    Inpatient bedside discharge medication dispensing and delivery status.
    MockHospitalEhrGateway
    Prototype mock implementation of HospitalEhrGateway returning synthetic electronic health records.
    MockSisterHospitalGateway
    Prototype mock implementation of SisterHospitalGateway returning simulated fast-track referral confirmations.
    OverrideReasonCode
    Approved operational and clinical reason codes required when a BMU operator overrides solver bed recommendations.
    Patient
    Entity representing an individual patient admitted to the hospital or emergency department, including masked identification, clinical attributes, and public queue token.
    PatientActionRequest
    Request payload for logging patient self-service interactions from the tracking portal.
    PatientAuditInteraction
    Entity capturing patient and family interactions on the public tracking portal for compliance auditing and communication engagement analytics.
    PatientAuditInteractionRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for logging and querying PatientAuditInteraction events.
    PatientEhrSummary
    Summary DTO containing patient clinical baseline information from the Electronic Health Record (EHR).
    PatientMilestoneResponse
    Response payload returned to the patient tracker portal detailing the patient's queue position, estimated wait time, assigned bed/ward milestones, and delay explanations.
    PatientRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Patient demographic and clinical profiles.
    PatientTrackerController
    REST controller for Patient and Family Journey Tracking operations.
    PatientTrackerService
    Service managing the patient and family queue journey experience.
    PrototypeSecurityConfig
    Prototype security configuration — active only under @Profile("prototype").
    PrototypeSecurityFilter
    Prototype servlet filter translating X-User-Role HTTP headers into mock Spring Security authentication.
    SafetyInvariantViolationException
    Exception thrown when an attempted bed allocation violates non-negotiable patient safety invariants (such as biological gender cohorting in multi-bed rooms or placing infectious patients in non-isolated rooms).
    SecurityConfig
    Default security configuration — active when no prototype profile is set.
    SisterHospitalGateway
    Gateway contract for transmitting subacute diversion referrals to external sister or community hospitals.
    SisterHospitalReferralResponse
    Response payload confirming receipt and dispatch of an acute referral to a sister hospital.
    SpecialistConsultRequest
    Request payload submitted by a consulting specialist recording secondary acuity assessment and diversion recommendations.
    SpecialtyCluster
    Clinical specialty clusters for patient diagnosis categorization and ward allocation affinity.
    TimefoldBedAllocationSolver
    Production-ready constraint satisfaction solver using the Timefold (OptaPlanner) optimization engine.
    TurnoverSlaStatus
    Service level agreement status for 30-minute terminal bed sanitization turnover.
    TurnoverTaskDto
    DTO representing an active bed turnover cleaning task for Environmental Services (EVS).
    Ward
    Entity representing an inpatient hospital ward, including floor level, ward class, specialty cluster alignment, negative pressure capability, and associated beds.
    WardClass
    Inpatient ward accommodation classes corresponding to government subsidy levels.
    WardController
    REST controller for inpatient ward operations, discharge runways, morning authorizations, bedside medication delivery, and turnover tasks.
    WardDto
    Data transfer record representing a ward along with its beds and cohort locking status.
    WardRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for inpatient Ward entities.
    WardService
    Service managing inpatient discharge runways, advance EDD forecasting, morning discharge sign-offs, bedside medication delivery, and turnover tasks.
